metadata.article_title: Copies of judgment and decree to be furnished to parties.

article.title: Copies of judgment and decree to be furnished to parties.
article.content:
36Copies of judgment and decree to be furnished to parties.

Order 41, Rule 36
Certified copies of the judgment and decree in appeal shall be furnished to the parties on application to the Appellate Court and at their expense.
